rows.grounds: compound ekakāla; adverbial accusative of time

items.question: May all remaining deities be worshipped together at one time instead?
premises: All other deities may be worshipped together.
items.inference: The verse permits worshipping all remaining deities together at one time as an alternative.
uncertainties: Exact ritual scope of 'all other' is not specified.
Whether ekakālaṃ modifies samarcayet or the whole rite is ambiguous.
items.plain_english: Or, one may worship all the other deities together at one time.
